title: 第29章 鱼没钓上，怎么钓上个这玩意？
novel_title: 宗门收徒，我能看见属性词条
content_zh:
东西虽多，但大部分东西现在看上去实在是想不到什么场合可以用。

    尤其是那些锅碗瓢盆，楚星尘害怕该不会是什么高僧骨灰造的碗盆吧？

    自己可没有习惯拿别人头盖骨当饭碗的习惯。

    所以那些长相奇特的锅碗瓢盆在楚星尘的勒令之下，一律不准进厨房。

    至于其他东西，李应灵要的就拿回自己房间去，不要的就通通扔到没人住的偏房里去。

    另外，那个高僧圆寂的木鱼……

    实在不知道这玩意是好是坏。

    楚星尘让李应灵自行处理去，反正让自己看见就会拿那个木鱼锤，锤她的小脑袋瓜。

    所以这一堆东西虽然多，但挑挑拣拣之后，没几样是靠谱能用的。

    好在这被子也不是什么高僧或者高人献祭过的。

    只是普通的丝绸被子。

    要不然晚上睡觉楚星尘睡觉恐怕总会感觉有人压在自己身上。

    经过整理，那一堆东西基本进了偏房。

    加之卫生也不用打扫。

    三人很快就在楚星尘的卧室里集合了，随后面面相觑的准备开个宗门全体会议。

    楚星尘拿出空间戒指中的血气灵石放在桌子上：

    “那个矿场灵石全都被血气沾染成这模样了。”

    厉行天眉头微皱，自己在矿场传送用的灵石便是这种灵石，原先以为没有几块，师父只是先将这些灵石拿去先用。

    “这怎么了？”李应灵拿起血气灵石左右瞧了瞧，“好像也没啥问题吧？”

    李应灵是修仙白痴，毕竟也没修多久，纯粹靠着天赋蹭蹭上涨修为，修仙常识全靠看小说话本了解。

    对她来说，这灵石无非是换了个色罢了，她也能感觉到这灵石内的灵气含量没有减少。

    充其量无非就是染了个不好看的颜色。

    楚星尘生动举例道：“假设你在镇妖司大门口把这玩意拿出来，你能爬的出来，那都算那群废物吃的是软饭。”

    李应灵闻言瞬间懂了：

    “那师父那我们这次来渝州城，就是为了解决灵石问题的？”

    “对，我已经拜托人帮忙解决了。”楚星尘轻轻点头。

    “接下来这段时间，你们老老实实修炼即可，等灵石问题解决，咱们再去找个好地方去。”

    厉行天点头示意自己明白了。

    李应灵确实有自己的小主意，小嘴一嘟，目光哀求的看向自家师父道：
content_en:
Although there are many things, most of them seem to be of no use in any occasion.

    Especially those pots and pans. Chu Xingchen was afraid that they were made from the ashes of some eminent monk, right?

    I am not in the habit of using other people's skulls as my livelihood.

    Therefore, those strange-looking pots and pans were not allowed to enter the kitchen under Chu Xingchen's order.

    As for other things, Li Yingling took what he wanted back to his room and threw everything he didn't need into an unoccupied side room.

    In addition, the wooden fish in which the eminent monk passed away...

    I really don’t know if this thing is good or bad.

    Chu Xingchen let Li Yingling handle it by herself. Anyway, if he saw it, he would hit her little head with that wooden fish hammer.

    So although there are a lot of things in this pile, after picking and choosing, few of them are reliable and usable.

    Fortunately, this quilt was not sacrificed by some eminent monk or master.

    Just a regular silk quilt.

    Otherwise, Chu Xingchen would always feel like someone was pressing on him when he went to bed at night.

    After sorting it out, the pile of things basically went into the side room.

    In addition, there is no need for cleaning.

    The three of them quickly gathered in Chu Xingchen's bedroom, and then looked at each other and prepared to hold a general meeting of the sect.

    Chu Xingchen took out the blood spirit stone in the space ring and placed it on the table:

    "The spiritual stones in that mine are all stained by blood and look like this."

    Li Xingtian frowned slightly. The spiritual stone he used for teleportation in the mine was this kind of spiritual stone. He originally thought there were only a few of them, so the master just took these spiritual stones and used them first.

    "What's wrong?" Li Yingling picked up the blood spirit stone and looked around, "It seems there's nothing wrong with it, right?"

    Li Yingling is an idiot in cultivating immortals. After all, he hasn't been cultivating for long. He only relies on his talent to improve his cultivation level. He only understands the knowledge of cultivating immortals by reading novels.

    To her, the spirit stone just changed color, and she could feel that the spiritual energy content in the spirit stone had not decreased.

    At best, it's just dyed an unsightly color.

    Chu Xingchen vividly gave an example: "Suppose you take this thing out at the gate of the Demon Suppression Department and you can crawl out, then those losers are just eating soft food."

    Li Yingling understood instantly when he heard this:

    "Master, the reason why we came to Yuzhou City this time is to solve the problem of spiritual stones?"

    "Yes, I have asked someone to help solve the problem." Chu Xingchen nodded lightly.

    "In the next period of time, you just need to practice diligently. When the spiritual stone problem is solved, we will find a good place."

    Li Xingtian nodded to indicate that he understood.

    Li Yingling did have his own little idea. He pouted, looked at his master with pleading eyes and said:
title_en: Chapter 29 If I didn’t catch the fish, how could I catch this thing?
